sph_interpretive_translation: Those whose consciousness is overwhelmed by anger, elation, intoxication, distress, childishness, madness, fear, agitation, drunkenness, extreme old age, abandonment, concealment, or grief—such beings are not fit to discharge legal responsibility nor sustain juridical capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives only from stabilized consciousness
Causation is traced to disruption in conscious integrity
Restoration logic begins with removal of consciousness-obstructing conditions
Consciousness alignment precedes all legal standing
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent_state IN [anger, elation, intoxication, distress, childishness, madness, fear, agitation, drunkenness, extreme_old_age, abandonment, concealment, grief] THEN legal_capacity = FALSE
IF legal_capacity = FALSE THEN jurisdiction_exclusion = TRUE UNTIL consciousness_restoration_confirmed
IF agent_consciousness_stability < threshold THEN no_dharma_binding = TRUE
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, any act performed under the influence of consciousness-disrupting states must be deemed legally void ab initio. The court shall assess not the act itself but the consciousness-state of the actor at the moment of enactment. Only upon verified restoration of conscious integrity may legal re-engagement occur.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that action arises from a stable cognizer. When consciousness is disrupted, agency dissolves. Thus, no punitive response is valid; only restoration of causal clarity aligns with Nyaya. Responsibility follows cognition, not consequence. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that disordered consciousness precedes disorderly acts. Hence, punitive framing mislocates causality.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Consciousness Stabilization Protocol (CSP) to neutralize disruptive emotional-affective states
Enforce Completion Process for unresolved trauma or grief obstructing cognitive clarity
Assign Guided Reintegration Practice under qualified supervision
Implement Temporary Legal Suspension until verified consciousness coherence is restored
Deploy Integrity Reclamation Sequence to realign personal dharma with universal Dharma
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma, this ruling executes Sanatana Jurisprudence. Consciousness is the sole arbiter. No punishment arises where understanding was absent. Dharma is restored through alignment, not vengeance. Reality responds only to awakened presence.
